COMPLEMENTARY.headline: 对一个人来说多余的东西，对另一个人来说却是缺失的一环。
COMPLEMENTARY.body: 你们元素间的平衡能相互弥补彼此的不足。这不仅仅是化学反应——更是结构层面的。在这里，你们可以构建出持久稳固的事物。

BALANCED.headline: 你的元素逐渐融入一种轻松的节奏中。
BALANCED.body: 你们两人都没有压过对方。既有足够多的共同点，让人感到被理解；也有足够多的不同之处，让人能够不断成长。

MODERATE.headline: 基本匹配是可行的——但并非自动实现的。
MODERATE.body: 你们并非天生就契合，但也不会发生冲突。这段关系需要去经营，而非唾手可得。

TENSION.headline: 你们有太多共同点。
TENSION.body: 两者都处于亢奋状态（或都处于冷淡状态）会让人感到压力重重却无处宣泄。你需要有人来打破这种循环——无论是日常习惯、朋友，还是物理空间。

DEFAULT.headline: 你们的元素仍在相互了解。
DEFAULT.body: 这里没有明显的元素特征。留意你们各自的能量恢复方式——那才是关键线索。

COMPLEMENTARY.headline: A nurturing family dynamic where generational strengths lift everyone up.
COMPLEMENTARY.body: Your essential energies flow together to create a deeply comforting and supportive home environment. Where one family member lacks patience or vision, the other naturally supplies grounding care or warm encouragement. This mutual nourishment helps the entire household feel secure, valued, and understood.

BALANCED.headline: A tranquil family environment rooted in shared heritage and unspoken understanding.
BALANCED.body: Sharing a similar foundational rhythm creates an easy, calm atmosphere within your family circle. You navigate domestic life with minimal friction because your core expectations align so naturally. This innate harmony provides a solid emotional bedrock that protects your household through all seasons.

MODERATE.headline: A adaptable family bond that thrives when individual differences are honored.
MODERATE.body: Your family unit balances comforting familiarity with healthy individual perspectives across generations. Respecting differing daily habits and personal preferences keeps communication open and warm. By celebrating what makes each person unique, you cultivate a resilient and inclusive home.

TENSION.headline: A transformative family dynamic where patience bridges generational contrasts.
TENSION.body: Distinct personal viewpoints can occasionally cause emotional friction during family gatherings. However, choosing empathy over the need to be right allows these differences to foster deep personal maturity. With mindful communication, your household learns to turn generational gaps into bridges of wisdom.

DEFAULT.headline: A steadfast family sanctuary built on unconditional support and care.
DEFAULT.body: Your connection serves as a reliable harbor where every family member finds acceptance and warmth. By offering gentle patience and listening without immediate judgment, you keep family ties strong. This quiet commitment to unconditional support ensures your home remains a safe haven.

COMPLEMENTARY.headline: A dynamic friendship where your strengths effortlessly fill each other's gaps.
COMPLEMENTARY.body: Your distinct personal energies flow together naturally, allowing you to inspire and uplift one another in everyday life. When one feels stuck, the other naturally offers the missing perspective to keep momentum going. Together, you form a well-rounded partnership where mutual growth feels completely effortless.

BALANCED.headline: An easygoing bond grounded in deep mutual understanding and shared rhythms.
BALANCED.body: Because you process life through a similar lens, spending time together feels instantly comforting and familiar. You rarely need lengthy explanations to get your points across, making your interactions relaxed and genuine. This natural harmony creates a safe, enduring space where both of you can truly be yourselves.

MODERATE.headline: A versatile connection that thrives when you cultivate shared interests.
MODERATE.body: Your friendship possesses a healthy blend of common ground and unique individual traits. As long as you maintain clear communication, your slight differences bring welcome variety rather than friction. Engaging in creative activities or joint hobbies will continuously deepen your mutual bond.

TENSION.headline: A stimulating dynamic that encourages personal breakthroughs through honest contrast.
TENSION.body: Your contrasting styles may occasionally spark lively debates, but this friction holds incredible potential for personal growth. By respecting each other's boundaries, you learn to see the world from entirely new angles. Treating differences as opportunities rather than obstacles turns this dynamic into a powerful catalyst for maturity.

DEFAULT.headline: A unique friendship built on curiosity, respect, and mutual discovery.
DEFAULT.body: Your relationship offers a fresh playground where both of you can explore new ideas without fear of judgment. By listening openly and celebrating your distinct personalities, you unlock a steady stream of shared inspiration. Honoring each other's individual pacing ensures a lasting, meaningful connection.

STEM_UNION.headline: 按照传统，你的日主通常是一对。
STEM_UNION.body: 在古典四柱命理中，这种干支组合是最为契合的之一。其中蕴含着一种直觉上的“我们天生一对”的感觉。

STEM_CLASH.headline: 你的日主之间相互制衡。
STEM_CLASH.body: 这是一种有意义的摩擦——你们彼此磨砺，让对方变得更锋利。但若没有休息，这些锋芒终将把你磨垮。

BRANCH_UNION.headline: 你那天的树枝很容易就缠在一起了。
BRANCH_UNION.body: 同样的节奏，同样的亲密本能。这种羁绊很快就让人感到熟悉，这很美妙——但有时也会让人迷失方向。

BRANCH_CLASH.headline: 你们的日支直接相冲。
BRANCH_CLASH.body: 你们会相互触动——往往是在自己察觉之前。关键在于不要把每次冲突都往心里去。

TEN_GOD_FRIEND.headline: 你们彼此视作平等的伙伴。
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.body: 平等是你的常态。虽然有时你会与人竞争，但你并不需要别人照顾。

TEN_GOD_WEALTH.headline: 你们其中一人觉得自己被对方视为有价值的人。
TEN_GOD_WEALTH.body: 人们天生就有种想要共同创造些切实事物——无论是资源、家园还是未来——的本能。要留意“给予者/接受者”这种动态关系是否变得单方面了。

TEN_GOD_OFFICER.headline: 这种结构会将你们两人相互吸引。
TEN_GOD_OFFICER.body: 一个人天生就想领导、保护或规范。另一个人则感到被呵护——或者被推着走。如果能把这些想法说出来，这两种心态都有其价值。

TEN_GOD_OUTPUT.headline: 你们其中一人因另一人而感到解脱。
TEN_GOD_OUTPUT.body: 这里有一种轻松的慷慨——思想、活力、欢笑。不要让那个富有表现力的人在得不到反馈的情况下耗尽心力。

TEN_GOD_RESOURCE.headline: 你们其中一人感到得到了另一方的支持。
TEN_GOD_RESOURCE.body: 其中蕴含着一种温柔、近乎母性或父性的特质。要小心，别让其中一人永远当老师，另一人永远当学生。

MIXED.headline: 你的日主们以一种更含蓄的方式相互吸引。
MIXED.body: 没有戏剧性的融合或冲突——这种默契是微妙的，需要随着时间的推移逐渐领悟。相信这些积累的证据。

MIXED.body: 没有戏剧性的融合或冲突——这种默契是微妙的，需要随着时间的推移逐渐领悟。相信这些积累的证据。

COMPLEMENTARY.headline: A deeply supportive core connection that fortifies your family's emotional foundation.
COMPLEMENTARY.body: Your underlying spirits reinforce each other, providing immense strength during challenging family moments. You instinctively know how to restore your relative's confidence when life feels overwhelming. This deep emotional alignment forms an steady pillars of love within your household.

BALANCED.headline: A steady, dependable kinship anchored in shared roots and common values.
BALANCED.body: Your core identities resonate on a deep, instinctual level, making your familial relationship deeply comforting. You share an unspoken understanding regarding duty, heritage, and household priorities. This steady alignment helps your family navigate major life transitions with calm unity.

MODERATE.headline: A warm kinship that flourishes through open heart-to-heart conversations.
MODERATE.body: Your fundamental traits bring a healthy diversity of thought to your family conversations. While you may process emotions differently, your shared commitment to the family keeps you close. Dedicating time to quiet, open dialogue ensures mutual respect remains strong.

TENSION.headline: A powerful familial mirror that encourages deep empathy and personal evolution.
TENSION.body: Differing core outlooks may occasionally challenge your family's traditional ways of doing things. Approaching these moments with genuine compassion turns potential conflict into deep emotional growth. Embracing each other's authentic selves creates a mature, lasting family bond.

DEFAULT.headline: A resilient family connection defined by enduring loyalty and unconditional care.
DEFAULT.body: Your bond transcends temporary disagreements, anchored firmly in lifelong family commitment. You offer a steady, non-judgmental presence that allows loved ones to feel completely safe. This quiet loyalty keeps your family unit connected through all of life's changes.

COMPLEMENTARY.headline: An empowering peer synergy where core identities champion one another.
COMPLEMENTARY.body: Your fundamental drives align in a way that fuels individual confidence and creative courage. You serve as steadfast sounding boards for each other's dreams, offering encouragement right when it matters most. This reciprocal cheerleading turns your friendship into an invaluable anchor.

BALANCED.headline: A harmonious companionship marked by shared values and steady trust.
BALANCED.body: You walk at a remarkably similar pace, making your shared journey feel balanced and secure. There is a quiet confidence in knowing you view core life principles through the same lens. This deep-seated alignment keeps your friendship resilient through changing seasons.

MODERATE.headline: A flexible peer bond that grows stronger through active listening.
MODERATE.body: Your core identities offer just enough difference to keep your conversations engaging and insightful. While your approaches to problem-solving may vary, your shared respect ensures smooth collaboration. Taking time to truly listen allows you to learn immensely from one another.

TENSION.headline: A transformative peer dynamic that challenges you to expand your horizons.
TENSION.body: Your core approaches to life occasionally clash, forcing both of you to step outside your comfort zones. If approached with patience, these moments of friction sharpen your self-awareness and broaden your worldview. Embracing this sharp contrast transforms potential misunderstanding into deep mutual respect.

DEFAULT.headline: A genuine peer bond defined by authentic presence and mutual respect.
DEFAULT.body: You meet each other on equal footing, bringing your true selves to every interaction. This straightforward connection allows you to share both triumphs and quiet moments with total ease. Nurturing this bond with consistent kindness keeps your mutual trust strong over time.

COMPLEMENTARY.headline: 你们的工作方式和理财方式很契合。
COMPLEMENTARY.body: 一个负责搭建框架，另一个则带来动力。无论是小型项目还是共同生活，你们都会是一支默契的搭档。

MIRROR.headline: 你对待生活的方式也是一样的。
MIRROR.body: 因为熟悉，所以让人感到安全。但镜像模式无法发展——必须有人引入新元素。

TENSION.headline: 你在工作和金钱方面的直觉相互矛盾。
TENSION.body: 你们每个人都会想按自己的方式做事。这并不是一票否决的事——但这需要开诚布公地沟通。

NEUTRAL.headline: 你们的工作方式和理财方式是相容的，但并不完全一致。
NEUTRAL.body: 既没有天然的默契，也没有天然的冲突。你们将共同设计出这种节奏。

DEFAULT.headline: 你们的工作方式各有各的特点。
DEFAULT.body: 留意你们每个人是如何处理一个小决定的——模式就藏在其中。

COMPLEMENTARY.body: 一个负责搭建框架，另一个则带来动力。无论是小项目还是共同生活，你们都会是一支默契的搭档。

DEFAULT.headline: 你们的工作方式各有各的特点。
DEFAULT.body: 请留意你们每个人是如何处理一个小决定的——模式就体现在这里。

COMPLEMENTARY.headline: A harmonious domestic rhythm where family roles support one another.
COMPLEMENTARY.body: The way you handle responsibilities and home life perfectly complements your family member's natural style. Tasks and caregiving flow smoothly because each person intuitively steps into their most helpful role. This natural synergy reduces domestic stress and creates a peaceful, well-ordered home.

BALANCED.headline: A predictable domestic dynamic that simplifies household life and planning.
BALANCED.body: You share similar approaches to family duties, making decisions about home matters straightforward and calm. This shared understanding reduces friction over daily routines and long-term family goals. Your predictable rhythm brings a reassuring sense of stability to everyone involved.

MODERATE.headline: A flexible family structure enriched by diverse talents and perspectives.
MODERATE.body: Your household benefits from a rich mix of practical skills, emotional warmth, and strategic thinking. By encouraging each member to contribute in their own way, family life stays vibrant and balanced. Recognizing these varied contributions fosters a supportive environment for all.

TENSION.headline: A dynamic home atmosphere that thrives on mutual flexibility and boundaries.
TENSION.body: Vast differences in how you approach responsibilities can sometimes spark disagreement over family priorities. Practicing gentle flexibility and establishing clear personal space helps resolve these frictions quickly. Viewing different styles as assets rather than faults restores harmony to your household.

DEFAULT.headline: A loving family structure where every member feels valued and supported.
DEFAULT.body: You maintain a gentle, accommodating structure that gives everyone room to grow at their own pace. Offering quiet help and celebrating small family milestones keeps household morale high. This supportive framework ensures that your home remains a place of true refuge.

COMPLEMENTARY.headline: A highly productive alliance where your behavioral styles achieve total balance.
COMPLEMENTARY.body: The way you navigate daily tasks and social dynamics naturally complements your friend's practical rhythm. Where one takes the lead with action, the other supports with steady strategy or creative insight. This natural division of momentum makes working or hanging out together deeply satisfying.

BALANCED.headline: A familiar cadence where shared habits build seamless collaboration.
BALANCED.body: Your action styles and daily habits mirror each other, creating an easy, predictable rhythm in your friendship. You intuitively understand each other's boundaries and motivations, minimizing unnecessary misunderstandings. This shared cadence makes organizing group events or shared projects completely stress-free.

MODERATE.headline: A balanced social connection enriched by complementary perspectives.
MODERATE.body: You combine different behavioral tendencies that give your friendship a rich, multi-layered feel. While one may prefer spontaneous fun, the other might bring grounding stability to your plans. Embracing these distinct rhythms keeps your shared time vibrant and well-rounded.

TENSION.headline: A high-energy friendship that sparks growth when managed with empathy.
TENSION.body: Your contrasting ways of handling goals and social situations can sometimes lead to unexpected friction. However, learning to appreciate your friend's distinct style teaches you valuable flexibility and patience. Channeling this dynamic energy into healthy competition pushes both of you toward excellence.

DEFAULT.headline: A supportive fellowship where individual strengths shine side by side.
DEFAULT.body: You give each other the space needed to express personal talents without feeling overshadowed. This respectful boundary creates an environment of genuine encouragement and freedom. Supporting each other's individual goals strengthens the overall health of your friendship.

SHARED_ATTRACTION.headline: 你们俩都极具魅力。
SHARED_ATTRACTION.body: 你们之间有种默契，连旁人都看出来了。这是真的。但这还不够——要在这种默契的基础上再打下基础。

SHARED_DEPTH.headline: 你们俩都生活在一个深邃的内心世界里。
SHARED_DEPTH.body: 你可以走到大多数情侣无法企及的地方。风险在于，你们俩可能会在同一时刻默默地退缩。

SHARED_WANDER.headline: 你们俩都是坐不住的人。
SHARED_WANDER.body: 你们之间来去自如。无论是在身体上还是情感上，停留在原地才是真正的挑战。

SHARED_LEADERSHIP.headline: 你们俩都想当领导。
SHARED_LEADERSHIP.body: 如果不划分地盘，你们就会发生冲突。明确的权限范围会改变一切。

SHARED_RESONANCE.headline: 你们都有一个共同的特点。
SHARED_RESONANCE.body: 这里有一种不言而喻的默契。善加利用吧——当关系建立在双方共同经历的基础上时，它才会更加牢固。

OPPOSITE_PULL.headline: 你的特质各执一词。
OPPOSITE_PULL.body: 你们各自都会为对方带来对方所缺乏的东西。这既是礼物，也是负担——由你们决定将其视为哪一种。

SINGLE_ANCHOR.headline: 你们当中有一人拥有一个罕见的特征。
SINGLE_ANCHOR.body: 另一个是见证者——通常也是定海神针。不要让见证者的角色变得无足轻重。

NEITHER.headline: 你们俩在“特殊特质”轴上都没有偏向。
NEITHER.body: 这段关系建立在其他因素之上——你的选择、你的付出、你的时间。

DEFAULT.headline: 你们各自的独特特质仍在相互交融。
DEFAULT.body: 注意一下，当没人注意的时候，你们每个人会伸手去拿什么。

COMPLEMENTARY.headline: A vibrant family connection filled with warmth, laughter, and shared joy.
COMPLEMENTARY.body: A bright, joyful energy permeates your relationship, bringing celebration and warmth to family gatherings. You have a natural ability to lift spirits and create cherished memories during holidays and everyday moments. This uplifting presence keeps your family bonds feeling genuinely joyful.

BALANCED.headline: A deeply rooted family bond offering quiet protection and lifelong safety.
BALANCED.body: Your relationship acts as a comforting anchor, shielding family members from external stress and uncertainty. Knowing you have each other's back creates a deep sense of psychological safety. This grounded connection remains a constant source of strength throughout your lives.

MODERATE.headline: An evolving kinship that grows richer through shared milestones and stories.
MODERATE.body: Your family connection continuously deepens as you honor traditions while creating new memories together. Navigating life's chapters together brings fresh wisdom and appreciation to your bond. Staying engaged in each other's lives keeps your kinship vibrant across generations.

TENSION.headline: A deeply emotional family bond that matures through conscious understanding.
TENSION.body: High emotional sensitivity in your connection means family topics can sometimes carry intense weight. Taking a step back to listen with patience diffuses emotional tension before it turns into misunderstanding. Nurturing this bond with gentle care turns vulnerability into lasting trust.

DEFAULT.headline: A timeless family bond grounded in deep acceptance and quiet devotion.
DEFAULT.body: Your family connection is built on a quiet, enduring promise to stand by one another no matter what. Through every season of life, your steadfast presence provides a comforting sense of home. This unconditional acceptance is the greatest gift you offer to one another.

COMPLEMENTARY.headline: A special bond sparked by memorable experiences and mutual inspiration.
COMPLEMENTARY.body: There is a natural charm in your connection that turns ordinary moments into lasting memories. You bring out a lighter, more creative side in each other whenever you gather. This lively energy keeps your friendship feeling fresh, vibrant, and continually inspiring.

BALANCED.headline: A grounded fellowship providing steady comfort and emotional safety.
BALANCED.body: Your connection offers a calming sanctuary from the busyness of the outside world. You can count on each other for consistent presence and quiet support during life's ups and downs. This steady dependability builds a deep, enduring sense of emotional security.

MODERATE.headline: An evolving friendship enriched by shared growth and mutual curiosity.
MODERATE.body: Your bond naturally adapts as both of you navigate different stages of life and personal evolution. Exploring new environments or learning together brings out the best in your dynamic. Staying curious about each other's journey ensures your friendship continues to flourish.

TENSION.headline: A intense connection that calls for clear boundaries and conscious patience.
TENSION.body: Strong emotional currents run through your relationship, making interactions vibrant yet occasionally sensitive. Practicing open communication prevents minor misunderstandings from escalating into unnecessary stress. By handling high-energy moments with grace, you build a resilient, deeply meaningful bond.

DEFAULT.headline: A meaningful connection anchored in genuine kindness and open trust.
DEFAULT.body: Your friendship develops naturally through quiet consistency and respectful boundaries. By celebrating each other's unique path, you create an enduring relationship that stands the test of time. Simple, authentic interactions remain the beating heart of your shared connection.

PEAK.headline: 罕见的结构契合。
PEAK.body: 这种组合在所有四个维度上都呈现出不同寻常的一致性。虽然这不能保证什么——但这意味着这种关系比大多数关系更能经得起考验。

FAVORABLE.headline: 一种能够共同成长的组合。
FAVORABLE.body: 并非轻而易举，而是有结构性的支撑。你所感受到的摩擦是富有成效的摩擦，而非破坏性的。

NEUTRAL.headline: 一段关系，是需要自己去经营的，而不是凭空得来的。
NEUTRAL.body: 这张图表就像是一块空白画布。你们俩如何利用它，完全取决于你们自己。

CAUTION.headline: 这是一种要求很高的组合。
CAUTION.body: 这里确实存在摩擦。这并不是离开的理由——而是要坦诚相待、及早沟通、经常交流的理由。

CHALLENGING.headline: 一种包罗万象的组合。
CHALLENGING.body: 这种结构对你不利。这并不决定结果——但这确实意味着你们双方都必须在大多数日子里有意识地保持这种意愿。

DISCLAIMER: 注：本相容性解读融合了天文计算与现代情感关系理论框架。这是一种象征性的、因人而异的解读——既非定论，亦非预言，更不能替代坦诚的沟通。你始终是这段关系的缔造者。

romance.tip: Focus on your emotional exchange. Understanding each other's love language can prevent unnecessary misunderstandings. (Romance Advice)

business.tip: Acknowledge differences in work styles and decision-making. Role division that leverages each other's strengths is the key to success. (Business Advice)

friend.tip: Focus on shared experiences and mutual respect. Keep the balance of giving and taking equal.

family.tip: Acknowledge generational differences and set healthy boundaries. Empathy over winning arguments.
